name: odometer-number
description: One huge number rolls up like an odometer (Indian digit grouping); with `from` it instead counts from→value as one legible tabular number (e.g. ₹1,00,000 → ₹86,468), set straight on the chapter field and double-underlined by hand. Use for the big reveal of a ₹ amount or %. tone red/green only on light fields (bone, note20, note50); on dark fields the number stays in the field ink. dy (px) nudges the whole composition down (+) or up (−) inside the content zone. labelSize / subSize (px, defaults 60 / 50) set the label and sub text size; use 80 or more for a headline-sized label.
